headline: Your trade sizing after losses is costing you.

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: Sizing up after a loss cost you ₹1,05,732, leading to a loss of ₹1,95,375. Your win rate after those trades was 28% versus 39% on other trades.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry is your usual size.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is emerging and worth keeping an eye on.

closing: Consider applying the rule about keeping your entry size after a loss for the next month.
